info.title: Flightdeck API
info.description: Stage 1 local-development API. Signed local sessions are demo-only and cannot be used in production. Flag metadata and revision are project-wide; enabled state is environment-specific. All mutations publish immediately and append transactional audit history. Archived flags evaluate false with reason archived; unknown flags are 404. Flag keys are immutable and never reused after archival.

localSession.name: fd_local_session
localSession.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict signed development session, issued only by explicit loopback development startup. Not a production authentication protocol.

evaluationBearer.description: Backend-only fd_ token, restricted to one organization/project/environment and evaluation operation; only its SHA256 verifier is stored.
